text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*~~. A makeup exam, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Spe? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Ah... Dober-san.
Umm, well...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I got a failing grade on my last test, so I have to take a makeup exam. But I'm totally falling behind on preparing for it...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Even looking back over my class notes makes no sense at all... Ahhh~~, what should I do?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I kept my old notebooks from back then... Do you want them?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I should have marked the sections likely to appear on the exam, so they might be helpful.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You're my academic savior, Dober-san! Thanks to you, I feel like I can give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Come on, you're exaggerating.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Giving it her all thanks to me... huh.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...She went out of her way to ask me for help, after all.
I have to support her properly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Would this reference book be good?
No, this one has more detailed explanations... 
Right, I'll prepare highlighters too.

When I entered the library, Mejiro Dober was sitting at a study desk.
In front of a pile of reference books, she was spreading out a notebook and checking it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
This is an important point. Let's box it in red.
For the commentary, I'll cite the one on this page...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. Is this enough?
Maybe I can improve it a bit more... Ah.

Mejiro Dober's elbow bumped into the stacked reference books, causing them to collapse and fall.
I picked them up and handed them to her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...! ...They're for a junior.
I promised to lend her my notes,
so I'm rewriting and summarizing them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, thank you...! 
Yeah, they're for a junior. I promised to lend my notes,
so I'm summarizing them again.

Looking closely, meticulous explanations had been added to make the content easier to understand.
The handwriting was also neat, conveying the writer's sincerity.

Looking closely, meticulous explanations had been added to make the content easier to understand.
The handwriting was also neat, conveying the writer's sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Not really... this much is normal, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You think so?
I feel like doing this much is pretty standard, though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Or rather, maybe having written too much
makes it harder to read...
choice_data_list: I think adding drawings would make it easy to understand!
How about explaining it to her verbally?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Or rather, maybe having written too much
makes it harder to read...
choice_data_list: I think adding drawings would make it easy to understand!
How about explaining it to her verbally?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Drawings, huh... True,
adding some illustrations might make the points stand out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Drawings, huh... You're right.
True, adding some illustrations might make things stand out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I'll give it a try.
Um... thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'll give it a shot.
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I passed the makeup exam~~~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to your notes, Dober-san!!
Really, truly, thank you so much~~!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Your illustrations are so cute after all, Dober-san!
Studying was way more fun than usual!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No... passing was because
you gave it your all, Spe.
...Well, I'm just glad I could help.

Afterwards, Mejiro Dober's illustrated notes
became rumored among the junior horse girls as the "Legendary Exam Prep Notes"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Wouldn't she think I'm being meddlesome?
choice_data_list: Being able to ask questions right on the spot is a great thing.
Being able to ask questions right on the spot is a great thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but...
Wouldn't that be overstepping my bounds?
choice_data_list: Being able to ask questions right on the spot is a great thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...True. In fact, that might actually be
more helpful...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...True. In fact, that might actually be
more helpful...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well, um... I'll give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you.
I'll give it a try, then.
The next day, in the library, I saw Mejiro Dober teaching Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Dober-san, about this part in the notebook... I don't quite get it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's an application of the formula I explained earlier.
Look, this part and this part...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see!
Your explanations are so easy to understand, Dober-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ! N-No, not really... That's not true...
Thanks to Mejiro Dober's explanations, Special Week's studies seemed to be progressing smoothly.
